coverage.overlapAssessment: 26 same-label parent/subcategory rows; hierarchy definitions absent; overlaps cannot be ruled out; no sums permitted

limitations: Published category-level amounts, not physician-level payments, invoices, vendor identities, a complete ledger, or independently verified bank transactions.
The source calls these payments but does not establish cash-versus-accrual accounting, netting, tax treatment, or reconciliation to consolidated accounts.
Currency is not established. The source metadata uses a USD presentation formatter; neither that UI setting nor Nova Scotia geography establishes the actual currency.
Source Year labels are retained; exact start/end dates are not supplied and are not inferred.
Category hierarchy, disjointness and completeness are not established. No totals, shares, growth calculations or sums across categories or years are provided.
Negative source values and explicit zeroes are valid reported values, not misconduct, missing data, or automatic anomalies.
Labels change across years. No category harmonization, recipient identity matching or budget-to-payment joins have been inferred.
Province-wide reporting cannot be allocated to Halifax, a council district, individual patients or service outcomes.
This is a frozen single complete CSV response, not a live monitor or a transactionally guaranteed multi-resource snapshot.
